name: koru.flow
in: KProg (wire-expressible flow grammar: graph x entry x args)
refuses: .k surface parse (no surface), C99 emission outside the declared subset (single main = bare int literal), unasserted thunk leaf, unhandled branch, catchall in bare dispatch, void+arms, bind-on-void-payload, non-bool guard, type error, zero float denominator, fuel exhausted
doc: The koru dialect, now with the self-host leg's first rung landed. Real eval semantics over the FlowView wire grammar (faithful port of w:/src/koru FlowKernel onto the K-grammar, rational-pair floats declared as the wire-level divergence); layer registry with encoding/grammar/semantics realized and .k declared-refusing. Emission: emitC99 realizes the declared subset (single-entry bare int literal -> 'int main(void) { return i; }', inside the CompCert-accepted C subset so the machine-checked leg to machine code stays available); KoruEmit adds quotation (KProg -> KVal) and kEmit, the same emission written as a KProg, with koru_emit_fixpoint witnessing agreement (accept + refuse directions) on koruEmitCorpus. Deferred obligations stated, not claimed: FlowEvalCongruent (ISK evaluator rung) and SelfHostingC99 at full strength (the forall-src compiler-correctness discharge).
